detail.definition: A conversation is one continuous exchange between a customer and your AI or team, from their first message until they have been quiet for 6 hours. It is not counted per message: one conversation can hold any number of messages, images and replies. If the same customer comes back within 6 hours it is still the same conversation; after 6 hours it is a new one. A conversation handed to a human agent stays one conversation until it is resolved. Conversations are counted per calendar month (UTC) and the count resets on the 1st. WhatsApp follows the same rule per chat.
